question: What effect does herbicide application have on invasive / non-native species abundance?

edges.subject: Grass-specific herbicide application
edges.sentence: Treatment was a significant predictor of non-native grass cover at only one site (Triangle Prairie; *F*4,14 =9.22, *p<*0.001), where plots that received applications of grass-specific herbicide had lower abundances of exotic grasses than the remaining disturbance treatments

edges.subject: SBG treatment (burning + glyphosate)
edges.object: decreased cover of non-native grasses (Agrostis spp.)
edges.sentence: Agrostis spp. were reduced most substantially by the SBG treatment (Figure 2b).

edges.subject: combination of burning and glyphosate application
edges.object: decreased cover of perennial non-native forbs
edges.sentence: Cover of perennial non-native forbs was significantly reduced with treatments that combined burning with glyphosate application (SBG, MBG; Figure 2c).

edges.subject: glyphosate application
edges.sentence: Non-native grass cover was reduced with glyphosate (Fig. 1).

edges.sentence: By 2006, above- and belowground densities of exotic species significantly increased and native species significantly decreased with one-time treatments of glyphosate and hand-pulling (ANOVA).
